countries.reasoning: Based on USGS and other industry reports from 2022-2023, the US is the largest producer of saline (commonly from salt mining and evaporative salt production); production numbers stable and well-documented.
China is a major saline producer with extensive salt lake and mine production; consistent data from national geological surveys and USGS 2023.
India produces significant amounts of salt (saline) especially from the Gujarat region; data from Indian Ministry of Mines and industry reports, slightly less precise than USGS.
Germany has a strong tradition of salt mining; stats from EU mineral databases and national sources indicate large production but less than top leaders.
Canada produces substantial saline from mines and solution mining; data from Natural Resources Canada and mining associations.
